# Human Feel: AI Tells to Remove

| Tell | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| Sample people contradict (local child, foreign-named parents; birth date disagrees with age) | One coherent family per project, stated in DESIGN.md and reused on every screen |
| Mixed illustration styles (flat vector, painting, photoreal) on one screen | One style named in DESIGN.md; regenerate outliers |
| Empty gradient or blank image placeholders | Real illustration or an empty state with one next step |
| Filler hints ("Pinch to zoom", "Swipe left to delete") | A visible control for the action |
| AI copy cliches ("Elevate", "Seamless", "Unleash") and English badges on a non-English screen | Short, warm copy in the product language |
| Invented metrics ("85th percentile" with no data source) | Plain-language status with the source, or no number |
| Screen title drift (a "Main Dashboard" that shows a lab result) | Title matches content; archive stale versions |
| Every section a card grid of identical tiles | Vary rhythm: one feature block, then a list, then tiles |
